test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Start a loop a little off a lane end
test.passLog: spline point 1 of 1 at .*%(on waypoint id=
test.hint: Spline tool, normal zoom. At a two-lane road end, click about 1 m off one lane's last waypoint. Ticks by itself.

test.title: End it a little off the other lane end
test.hint: Click round a loop. Click about 1 m off the other lane's last waypoint. Right-click. Ticks by itself. Then undo.

test.title: Zoomed far out, the loop still joins
test.passLog: a click near the start went on the end
test.hint: Zoom out until the two lane ends nearly touch. Draw the loop again, ending near the other lane end. Right-click. Ticks by itself. Undo.

test.title: Alt keeps the end loose
test.hint: Normal zoom. Draw the loop again. Hold Alt for the last click, 1 m off the other lane end. Right-click. Ticks by itself.
